title: How To Handle Disrespect Without Getting Angry

style.character: minimalist expressive stickman with circular white head, bold black vector ink strokes (6px-8px)
style.environment: minimal 2D hand-drawn doodle living room and social scenes, flat solid color fills, zero 3D, zero photorealism

pacing_rules.rule: Every line is mapped to a distinct 2D visual comic panel. Key long lines are split into two complementary visual beats.

cuts.text: What do you actually do when someone makes a slick joke at your expense
cuts.framing: Medium wide shot of group living room
cuts.visual_action: Inside the exact cozy 2D cartoon living room from @Scene_LivingRoom_Group_Anchor: Brad in a bright mustard-yellow shirt stands leaning forward over the coffee table, aggressively pointing an index finger directly across at Alex on the couch, smirking with an open mouth delivering a slick joke to the room. Bold black ink outlines on off-white canvas (#FAF9F6).

cuts.text: in front of everyone at a friend’s house?
cuts.framing: Reverse medium shot on protagonist with circle highlight
cuts.visual_action: The protagonist in his dark forest-green hoodie sitting on the grey couch, circled with a bold hand-drawn crimson marker circle ('⭕') highlighting him as the target. Around him, two background stickman friends on the couch turn their heads, watching the reaction. Clean 2D graphic novel art, zero 3D.

cuts.text: Most guys freeze.
cuts.framing: Punch-in medium shot: deer-in-headlights social stun
cuts.visual_action: Punch-in medium shot of the protagonist from @Scene_LivingRoom_Group_Anchor sitting right on the slate-grey couch: caught in complete psychological stun and social paralysis. Wide unblinking cartoon dot eyes, raised anxious eyebrows, mouth clamped in speechless disbelief, and a prominent cartoon sweat drop on his cheek. Subtle black ink shock tremor vibration lines radiate around his head to emphasize the sudden awkward silence and mental freeze. Slate-grey couch visible in background.

cuts.text: You either laugh along nervously to keep the peace,
cuts.framing: Medium close-up of forced fake laughter
cuts.visual_action: The protagonist from @Scene_LivingRoom_Group_Anchor sitting on the slate-grey couch forcing an awkward, strained smile with hands nervously rubbing together in front of his chest. Small hand-drawn comic laugh doodle notes floating near his mouth: 'HEHE...'. Floating label in faint grey ink above him: '[NERVOUS SMILE]'. Slate-grey couch in background.

cuts.text: or you get angry and ruin the whole vibe.
cuts.visual_action: Alternative mistake inside the exact room from @Scene_LivingRoom_Group_Anchor: The protagonist jumping up abruptly from the couch with clenched fists, red angry face lines, cartoon steam puffs blowing from his ears, while the friends in the armchairs recoil backward in awkward shock. Bold crimson red accent strokes (#FF3B30).

cuts.text: Look, both reactions hand all your power to them.
cuts.visual_action: Minimalist visual diagram: On the left, the protagonist in green hoodie. On the right, Brad in yellow. A golden glowing royal crown / steering wheel is flying out of the protagonist's open hands toward Brad, connected by a bold crimson dotted arrow labeled: 'STATUS SURRENDER'. Generous negative space.

cuts.text: Fake-laughing says you accept disrespect.
cuts.visual_action: The fake-laughing stickman with his strained smile, stamped squarely across his chest with a large rectangular bold red ink rubber stamp: '[ACCEPTED DISRESPECT]'. Bold black ink pen line art on off-white paper (#FAF9F6).

cuts.text: Getting angry shows they rattled you.
cuts.visual_action: In the center of the clean canvas, a flat horizontal seismograph/heart-rate monitor line that suddenly spikes wildly into a jagged crimson red danger zone (#FF3B30). Next to the spike, clean bold hand-lettered ink text: '[RATTLED]'. Single visual graphic punch.

cuts.text: Here’s what an experienced senior will tell you.
cuts.framing: Medium shot of older brother / senior figure
cuts.visual_action: An older, calm senior stickman figure leaning comfortably against a clean wooden doorframe. Dark neat jacket, hands loosely in pockets, looking directly at the camera with a reassuring, wise half-smile. A subtle glowing blue aura (#2563EB) around his silhouette.

cuts.text: Don’t get mad, and don’t raise your voice.
cuts.visual_action: Two clean minimalist hand-drawn ink icons side-by-side on the off-white paper canvas: On the left, an angry clenched red fist with a bold black 'X' over it. On the right, a loud megaphone blasting soundwaves with a bold black 'X' over it. Clean, balanced negative space.

cuts.text: Just look at them calmly,
cuts.visual_action: Tight close-up of the protagonist's face from @Scene_LivingRoom_Group_Anchor in his dark green hoodie. Calm, steady horizontal eyebrows, level dark dot eyes looking straight ahead with zero anger and zero flinching. Pure relaxed self-possession.

cuts.text: and ask with quiet curiosity:
cuts.visual_action: Protagonist from @Scene_LivingRoom_Group_Anchor slightly tilting his head to one side on the couch with genuine, calm curiosity, resting his chin lightly on two fingers as if genuinely trying to understand a puzzle. A subtle hand-drawn blue question mark doodle ('?') floating beside his head.

cuts.text: "Wait, I didn’t get it.
cuts.visual_action: A clean bold hand-drawn graphic card on off-white paper (#FAF9F6). In the center, bold hand-lettered black ink text in quotation marks: '"WAIT, I DIDN'T GET IT..."' with subtle radiating hand-drawn shockwave lines.

cuts.text: What’s the joke?"
cuts.framing: Medium profile: Protagonist speaking directly to Brad
cuts.visual_action: Side-profile two-shot in living room across the wooden table: The protagonist from @Scene_LivingRoom_Group_Anchor on the left in green hoodie speaking with a clean open hand gesture directly toward Brad on the right. Large bold hand-lettered ink text floating between them: '"WHAT'S THE JOKE?"'. Brad's arrogant smirk instantly begins to freeze.

cuts.text: Notice what happens next.
cuts.framing: Overhead cinematic 2D view of living room
cuts.visual_action: High-angle 2D view looking down on the exact living room from @Scene_LivingRoom_Group_Anchor. Every character is frozen in place. On the back wall, a minimalist cartoon wall clock with hand-drawn motion lines indicating a slow, heavy 'TICK... TOCK...'. Heavy anticipation.

cuts.text: The whole room goes quiet.
cuts.visual_action: The friends in the armchairs from @Scene_LivingRoom_Group_Anchor holding their soda cans completely still in mid-air. Wide cartoon dot eyes, straight neutral mouths, dead silence. A flatline doodle line with tiny musical rest notes floating in the air.

cuts.text: Sarcasm only survives on quick laughter.
cuts.scene_type: Visual Metaphor: The Laughter Oxygen Tank
cuts.visual_action: A hand-drawn minimalist 2D cartoon illustration: A glowing red flame labeled 'SARCASM' inside a glass jar. A pipe connected to an oxygen tank labeled 'ROOM LAUGHTER'. A large hand-drawn valve is shown turned completely shut, causing the flame to flicker into cold grey smoke.

cuts.text: The moment you force someone to explain their insult,
cuts.visual_action: Brad in his yellow long-sleeve tee standing completely alone under a single bright vertical yellow cartoon spotlight (#F59E0B) beaming down from the top frame. His smirk is completely wiped off, replaced by wide nervous eyes and three large cartoon sweat drops flying off his head.

cuts.text: they have to admit they were just being petty.
cuts.framing: Close-up of stammering mouth with scribble
cuts.visual_action: Close-up of Brad's face: his mouth open awkwardly, with a tangled squiggly ball of black scribble ink doodle coming out of his lips: 'UH... WELL...'. Stamped in bold black ink beneath him: '[EXPOSED PETTINESS]'.

cuts.text: They'll mumble, backpedal, and fold on the spot.
cuts.visual_action: Brad in his yellow shirt visibly shrinking downward, shoulders hunched forward, looking down at his sneakers with hands shoved awkwardly into his pockets, while subtle cartoon motion arrows point downward showing his complete loss of social status.

cuts.text: You don’t need to fight to command respect.
cuts.visual_action: The protagonist in his forest-green hoodie sitting back comfortably on the slate-grey couch from @Scene_LivingRoom_Group_Anchor, taking a slow sip from a simple white mug or glass, completely serene, grounded, and unbothered. A soft green aura of calm authority around him.

cuts.text: Just hold up the mirror,
cuts.framing: Close-up of hand holding clean mirror
cuts.visual_action: A clean minimalist close-up: A simple stickman hand in a dark green sleeve holding up a clean circular silver-rimmed hand mirror directly facing the camera, shining with two clean white comic glint stars ('✨').

cuts.text: and let them dismantle themselves.
cuts.framing: The mirror reflection revealing the jester's defeat
cuts.visual_action: Looking directly into the circular mirror: Inside the reflection, Brad in his yellow shirt is seen looking embarrassed and looking away. Beneath the mirror, bold clean hand-lettered ink text: 'THE MIRROR RULE' with a sleek circular arrow looping back to the top of the canvas.
